test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A building where animals are butchered
solution: The correct answer is: **Abattoir**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Abattoir"** refers to a building where animals are butchered for meat. (पशुओं का वधशाला) • **Example:** The meat processing company built a new abattoir to handle the increase in demand. • A **"Decanter"** is a vessel used for pouring liquids, often wine. (पदार्थ उड़ेलने का बर्तन) • **Example:** The waiter brought a decanter filled with red wine to the table. • Hence, the correct substitute for a building where animals are butchered is **'Abattoir'**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Abattoir**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Decanter** (पदार्थ उड़ेलने का बर्तन): A vessel used to pour liquids, typically wine. • **Example:** The elegant decanter added charm to the dinner table. • **Burrow** (पशुओं का बिल): A hole or tunnel dug by an animal for shelter. • **Example:** The rabbit disappeared into its burrow when it heard footsteps. • **Cemetery** (कब्रिस्तान): A place where dead bodies are buried. • **Example:** The cemetery was silent and serene, surrounded by tall trees. 14b:T97f, The correct answer is: **Option 3 (Repugnant)**.
